question: A fundraiser starts with 94 dollars. Donors add 75 dollars in the morning, then 67 more at noon, then 28 by evening (totaling 264 dollars). The amount is then tripled for a matching grant program (792 dollars). It is tripled again by a foundation (2376 dollars). How much money has the fundraiser accumulated?

A construction project begins with 75 minutes of material prep time. It gains 32 additional minutes, totaling 107. This is multiplied by 5 teams working in parallel (535 min-hours). Then 50 minutes are added for cleanup prep. The total effort is multiplied by 8 days (4280). Then 16 more inspection minutes are added, then 25 more. Another site has 30 minutes of work. How many total minutes of work time are recorded?

Sofia starts a jewel-making business with 153 pieces. She multiplies production by 6 (918). She loses 650 pieces to quality control (268). This total is multiplied by 5 (1340). A major defect costs 573 pieces. Morning work was significant, afternoon saw losses, evening showed the final inventory. How many finished pieces does Sofia have?

Ren and Jo are gardening partners. Ren starts with 159 seeds. He multiplies by 5 (795), then by 7 (5565). He divides by 5 to share equally (1113). He adds 74 more seeds. Jo has 500 seeds. How many seeds does Ren have for planting?

A factory processes 91 kilos of material daily. On day 1, it multiplies by 7 (637). On day 2, 58 more kilos arrive (695). On day 3, 34 kilos are removed (661). On day 4, 245 kilos are lost to spillage (416). On day 5, output is multiplied by 8 (3328). Finally, 2837 kilos are shipped. Morning shifts were heavy, afternoon saw losses, evening brought shipments. What is the remaining material?

A factory starts with 197 units of raw material. They lose 6 to defects (191). They multiply by 9 for production scheduling (1719). They lose 878 in processing (841). They multiply by 6 for supply planning (5046). They lose 1323 to shrinkage. How much material remains in inventory?

Pedro and Anna run a farm. Pedro starts with 37 acres. He adds 12 acres (49). He adds 53 more (102). He adds 74 more (176). He divides in half to separate crops (88 per section). He multiplies by 6 for yield calculations (528 units). He loses 147 to erosion. Anna manages twice as many acres total. How many acres does Pedro's calculation show?

A storage facility has 228 items. In the morning, it gains 6 (234). By afternoon, 43 are sold (191). By evening, 90 more are sold (101). Finally, 60 more are removed for returns (41). How many items remain in storage?

A recording studio starts with 194 minutes of audio. In the morning, it is divided by 2 (97 min). By afternoon, it is doubled (194 min). By evening, 60 more minutes are added (254 min). It is then doubled for backup (508 min). It is doubled again (1016 min). Finally, 40 minutes of bonus content are added. How much total audio time is recorded?

A print shop has 76 sheets of paper. In the morning, it multiplies by 8 (608). It adds 34 more sheets (642). At midday, 642 sheets are divided among 6 print jobs (107 per job). By evening, 79 sheets are damaged. How many usable sheets remain?

Rachel and Tom run a stationery store. Rachel starts with 180 pens. She adds 18 (198). She adds 12 more (210). She multiplies by 9 for wholesale packaging (1890). She loses 726 to a shipping accident (1164). She gains 12 replacement pens (1176). She multiplies by 4 for restocking (4704). Tom has 5000 pens. How many pens does Rachel end up with?
A candy maker has 25 pounds of candy. She multiplies by 7 (175), then by 2 (350), then by 9 (3150), then by 2 again (6300). A rival shop has 1000 pounds. How much candy does she have?

A juice vendor starts with 124 bottles. In the morning, he divides by 4 (31 bottles). He adds 16 (47). He loses 38 to spillage (9). He gains 35 from a resupply (44). He loses 28 to breakage. How many bottles remain?

A farmer starts with 44 acres. He multiplies by 4 (176). He loses 6 acres to development (170). He multiplies by 4 more times the initial (680). He multiplies by 9 for yield calculation (6120). How much productive area is he calculating?

A library starts with 105 books. They add 35 (140). They add 62 more (202). They multiply by 5 (1010). They lose 52 to damage (958). A sister library has 50 books. How many books does this library have?

A warehouse starts with 161 boxes. In the morning, 90 are shipped (71). By afternoon, 28 more leave (43). By evening, 17 more depart (26). Finally, 8 more are removed. How many boxes remain in the warehouse?

A pastry shop starts with 27 items. In the morning, they add 71 (98). By afternoon, they multiply by 6 (588). By evening, 51 more are made (639). Late in the day, 241 are sold. Morning was busy, afternoon was productive, evening was active. How many pastries remain?

Kate starts with 234 dollars. She doubles (468). She adds 14 (482). She adds 55 more (537). She doubles for a loan (1074). She multiplies by 6 (6444). She adds 27. Her brother has 5000 dollars. How much does Kate have?

A workshop starts with 112 tools. It gains 26 (138). It multiplies by 6 (828). It divides by 2 to share (414 per location). It loses 385 in a move (29). It gains 59 more. Two locations. How many tools does each location have?

A toy store starts with 33 items. They multiply by 8 (264). They add 23 (287). They add 35 more (322). They multiply by 5 for holiday stock (1610). A supply depot has 500 items. How many toys does the store have?

Will and Sue manage a fund. It starts with 131 dollars. They lose 127 (4). They add 76 (80). They lose 4 (76). They multiply by 9 (684). Sue has 500 dollars elsewhere. How much is in their joint fund?

A deli starts with 82 servings. They multiply by 8 (656). They add 15 (671). They double (1342). They add 56 (1398). They divide by 6 for portions. Half a dozen times the starting amount would be 492. How many portions are served?

A construction project starts with 178 hours. In the morning, 64 more hours are logged (242). The team multiplies by 7 (1694). By afternoon, 539 hours are completed (1155). By evening, 657 are done (498). Late night, 86 are completed. How many hours remain to convert from minutes to hours? Total hours worked?
A gym starts with 184 members. In the morning, 148 cancel (36). They add 53 (89). They multiply by 3 (267). They multiply by 9 (2403). They add 3 more. How many members does the gym now have?

A shop starts with 112 items. They lose 46 (66). They add 62 (128). They multiply by 4 (512). They add 52 (564). They add 73 more. A sister shop is mentioned. They convert some stock from minutes to hours. How much stock do they have?
